name: How does customer query research differ from standard keyword research?
description: GEO customer query research focuses on local and geographic-specific search terms, unlike standard keyword research which is more general.

mainEntity.name: How does customer query research differ from standard keyword research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard keyword research identifies general search terms, while customer query research for GEO specifically focuses on keywords and questions with local intent. It considers factors like 'near me' searches, city-specific queries, and regional service needs. This distinction allows businesses to tailor their digital marketing strategies to reach local audiences effectively, rather than broadly targeting a national or international market.
